resources.purpose: Quick-reference sheets or rule summaries for the rules system the scenario targets, so terms, ratings, and terrain effects match the rules exactly.
resources.whenMissing: Use only terminology the user supplies or that is confirmed in the user's own rules. Ask the user for any rules detail the scenario depends on instead of assuming it.
resources.howToObtain: Use the quick-reference sheet or rulebook you own for your rules system. Save a copy as a PDF or Markdown file.

resources.purpose: Local copies of the articles listed in references/further-reading.md, for deeper reasoning on design choices.
resources.whenMissing: Use the adapted guidance in scenario-design-patterns.md and the article links in references/further-reading.md.
resources.howToObtain: Read the articles at their source URLs. Save personal copies only where the source allows it.
resources.license: Each article belongs to its author. Not redistributable.
